scope: Continue with Arcaniste after approval of Traqueuse: five progressively protected outfits and matching compact default heads, for native64 review.

reference_roles.historical_base: Slender white-haired human male with copper/ceramic forearm implants only, not old armor geometry or rejected helmet scale.
reference_roles.accepted_traqueuse: Matte economical game-sprite finish only, not gender, outfit, silhouette or palette.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE whole original ARCANISTE male cyberpunk spellcaster player sprite, designed to read at60 pixels high inside a64×64 game cell. Complete figure from crown to soles, two empty hands, two separate feet, genuine transparent background with margins. No weapon, staff, wand, spell, flame, floating orb, aura, floor, cast shadow, logo or text.
Identity: a tall SLENDER adult HUMAN MAN, pale warm skin, short swept WHITE/SILVER HAIR when uncovered, a small restrained copper temple implant, calm severe face. Both forearms have engineered channeling implants housed in ceramic guards with broad dull copper cuffs. They are visually integrated equipment, not a full robot skeleton. Same male face and proportion through the range, no beard or old wizard caricature. Head normal and compact, about8–9 native pixels high INCLUDING headgear, short neck seated naturally in shoulders. Do not enlarge a helmet to fit face detail.
Class identity: a precise futuristic occult/fire channeler with an upright long slim silhouette, tailored split coat, broad ceramic forearm masses, a narrow vertical chest structure. Strong elegant vertical coat panels, no bulky melee brawler shoulders, no round robotic limb rings everywhere, no tactical sniper uniform or blue visor. No priest insignia, skulls, prayer scrolls, giant curved shoulder cape, huge hood, crown, pointed hat, horns or tall crest.
Palette: subdued MID-DARK PLUM / ASH VIOLET coat fabric, broad readable lavender-plum lit folds and darker burgundy-plum shadows. Warm light IVORY CERAMIC guards and pale stone head-protection planes. A few broad DULL COPPER fittings at forearm cuffs and waist, not orange points sprinkled everywhere. Dark brown-charcoal cloth trousers and practical boots beneath split coat. Light skin / ivory head surfaces must make the head clearly readable on a dark floor. No red-and-gold ceremonial robe, no luminous purple runes, no many tiny LEDs. Two or three calm values per material, large matte planes, no texture noise or scattered sharp highlights.
Rendering: polished compact game-sprite illustration, subtle elevated almost-frontal view and balanced stance, simple upper-left light, economical clean volume shading, restrained dark silhouette, no heavy black comic outlines around every little part. Adult human proportions, slim shoulders and waist, two empty hands slightly separated from torso, feet apart. No photo texture, tiny rivets, vents, strings, many straps, hanging pendants, wires, decorative lines, thin trim or small repeated beads. One or two broad folds per cloth area. Maintain useful spaces at arms and between feet.
Draw body and head together so the neck is short and well seated, never a separate oversized head perched on a long stalk. Every stage changes torso, arms/gloves, trousers/legs and boots together. The default HEAD PROTECTION must also evolve from bare head through light headwear to a compact matching full helmet. All ceramic head pieces use the same material and quiet angled forms as the torso and forearms.
No exposed abdomen or elaborate mystical costume. Futuristic engineered mage gear with calm cloth areas and a few large ceramic plates. This is a proposal for visuals, not new powers or gadgets. One full character only, no sprite sheet or head close-up.
STAGE1/5 VERY LIGHT: simple short sleeveless PLUM tunic to above the knees, pale ivory chest underlayer visible as one broad quiet central area. No hard torso shell or shoulder armor. Bare slender human upper arms; small smooth ivory forearm implant cuffs with one broad copper band each, thin dark gloves. Plain cloth trousers with modest knee reinforcement and narrow practical boots. The costume is light workwear, not already a complete armor. HEAD: bare pale male face and short swept silver hair, small copper temple implant only, no helmet or crown. About24 native pixels wide.
Input image is ONLY a crop of the new stage03 FACE identity and palette, not a body. Generate a NEW COMPLETE BODY AND OUTFIT for the stated stage. Keep the pale white-haired male identity, not the head crop's portrait scale. Remove or replace its medium headgear according to the head protection stage above. Do not copy its headwear on every level. The whole figure must be60 pixels tall in a64×64 tile, with a normal compact head, short neck, complete empty hands and feet. Rebuild the torso, coat length, sleeve protection, gloves, trousers and boots freely for the requested stage; make the amount of hard ceramic coverage and armor thickness clearly distinct.
jobs.reference_role: Face identity, compact head scale and palette only; new body coverage and head protection for each stage.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input is the EXACT whole Arcaniste stage04 character. Change ONLY the head protection. Keep the male human face, head size, head position, neck length, shoulders, torso, hands, legs, boots, coat, palette, pose and all body geometry unchanged.
Primary request: REPLACE the current plum cloth cap/coif and sparse small ornaments on the head with a compact OPEN-FACE IVORY CERAMIC HELMET. The helmet has a clearly visible broad pale ceramic CROWN CAP, a low continuous pale BROW, substantial close TEMPLE and CHEEK GUARDS. The whole human face from eyes to mouth remains open and pale warm skin. No face mask, visor, glasses or optic bar at this stage. The ivory material, quiet large angled planes and copper fittings match the torso and forearm ceramic guards exactly. Only one small copper temple attachment is enough; no extra dots.
At native64 this fourth-tier head must read as a PALE OPEN helmet, distinctly different from the plum soft coif in the medium stage. Most of the head perimeter is pale ivory, not dark purple. Keep normal SMALL adult human head scale, about8–9 pixels high when the figure is60 pixels tall. The top of the helmet stays at the same height as the current head, no tall crown, horns, spikes, fins, turban or oversized dome. Keep his short neck seated in the existing collar, no visible long stalk. The jaw is human, not a metal robot jaw; only the cheeks are guarded.
Do not redesign any armor below the head. Retain the entire complete figure, same framing and transparent background, no background, floor, shadow, effects, text or new object. Clean 2–3 large matte planes per material, no tiny vents or rivets. Head-only protection edit of the supplied complete character.
